status_note: DRAFT until frozen with tools/freeze_targets.py. Review every number, change what you disagree with, THEN freeze -- before any model is trained or evaluated on test. After freezing, a change needs a new file (targets_v2.json) and the report will show both.
rationale: The brief's single 'mAP@0.5:0.95 >= 0.68' mixes two jobs with different physics. Survey frames (high, fast, Jetson, INT8) must FIND dump sites. Evidence frames (low, offline ensemble + TTA + multi-view on the RTX 5090) must LOCALISE and CLASSIFY objects well enough for a report. mAP@0.5:0.95 punishes 1-px box errors on small objects, so it is only demanded where objects are >= 32 px. The 0.87 recall applies to the toxic (tier-1) classes, where a miss matters most. 'FP < 0.05' is read as FP/(TP+FP) at the operating threshold fixed on VAL.
operating_threshold: Chosen on VAL (08 --calibrate or 11's stage_thresholds.json) and passed with --conf to the TEST run. Never chosen on test.

site_definition.note: Objects closer than link_m form one site; a site is found if any detection touches any of its objects; nearby false detections count as one false alert.

evidence.scope: Output of 11_evidence_pipeline.py (final stage) on evidence-pass frames
